notes:
- Special thanks to EGOFALCON for testing this update in ways I wouldn't have
- Added Theme Creator (pop-out window with live preview, logo alignment, save/export as .f76theme)
- Added animated GIF logos for custom themes (up to 2 MB)
- Added Delete theme for custom themes (no restart needed)
- Added Update tab to update F76 Manager from Nexus (shows the Nexus changelog)
- Added mod presets: Default, Preset 1 and Preset 2 (create, rename, duplicate, delete - Default can't be deleted)
- Added preset export/import that brings the mods and their Nexus data with it
- Added Update mods in all presets setting and per-preset Receive mod updates option
- Added right-click menu on the mod list
- Added Nexus fetch on a mod's edit page (paste a Nexus link to link and update the mod)
- Added loose mod install (keeps folder structure in Data) with optional Pack to BA2
- Added F76AddTo INI files (F76AddToCustom, F76AddToPrefs, F76AddToFallout76) with Apply to INI
- Added Save button and Ctrl + S to every config editor
- Added Logs action menu (Clear Errors, Clear Logs, Share Logs, Pop Out) and Logs pop-out window
- Added Ko-fi link next to the platform switcher with a setting to hide it
- Added deeper conflict checks (same edits in the same file, not just the same file path)
- Added in-app confirm dialogs that match the tool style
- Added new Dashboard image
- Fixed BA2 compiling (proper compression and texture chunking) so mods packed by the manager load in game instead of crashing on boot
- Fixed loose mods leaving script/text files out of BA2 packs
- Fixed texture packing failing on common DDS formats (24-bit, 16-bit, half-float LUTs)
- Fixed empty placeholder files being left out of BA2 packs
- Fixed bundling general and texture mods from the mod list
- Fixed Deploy deploying mods from other presets instead of only the active one
- Fixed switching presets not applying that preset's mod list and enable state
- Fixed Browse mods to add not working on empty presets
- Fixed deleted presets coming back after switching presets
- Fixed preset import error banner
- Fixed Deploy moving configs (.ini/.json/.txt) into Disabled Mods (affected configs are restored on first launch)
- Fixed Deploy saving config edits (Deploy now only updates the archive list, plugins, and FOV sync - use Save / Ctrl + S for configs)
- Fixed installs overwriting list INIs like hudmodloader.ini instead of merging them
- Fixed configs in folders like Configuration and ModsData not showing in Configs
- Fixed Default Fallout 76 INIs not showing on every preset
- Fixed FOV breaking after saving an INI in the manager
- Fixed FOV above 120 (e.g. 130) not applying in game
- Fixed fDefaultFOV getting ignored
- Fixed Game Pass INI keeping disabled/deleted mods
- Fixed Game Pass instant reload not working
- Fixed string mods not showing or getting disabled after Deploy
- Fixed disabled mods disappearing from the mod list
- Fixed deleting mods needing multiple clicks
- Fixed Update This Mod showing on mods that are already up to date
- Fixed Nexus fetch only linking metadata instead of downloading/replacing the mod
- Fixed renaming loose mods
- Fixed Mod Manager Download links getting lost while the manager was starting
- Fixed update checks flooding Nexus
- Fixed App Update using Slow download instead of Mod Manager Download
- Fixed Update tab going stale after refresh
- Fixed closing the update banner not canceling the update
- Fixed mod list not refreshing after drag and drop
- Fixed Add Mod showing an error when clicked
- Fixed Configuration Health still saying Needs Attention after Auto Override + Deploy
- Fixed creating profiles
- Fixed profile not staying selected after restarting the manager
- Fixed manager starting on the wrong platform
- Fixed mod updates re-enabling disabled mods
- Fixed banners not closing and covering the Deploy button
- Fixed action menus getting cut off and not scrolling
- Fixed button hover colors not matching the selected theme
- Fixed Hide Ko-fi not actually hiding the Ko-fi link
- Fixed UI Animations setting not doing anything
- Fixed Logs refresh spam
- Fixed Logs pop-out missing its icon
- Improved startup speed
- Improved Red & Black, Vault-Tec and Enclave themes
- Improved title bar to match the selected theme
- Improved layout (compact conflict cards, headers, edit mod window and settings footer)
- Improved conflict badges (Differs/Harmless) to match the theme
- Improved config installs to merge new settings instead of overwriting
- Improved capitalization on common UI words (Create, Edit, Enable, Disable, etc.)
- Configs no longer link to Nexus mod IDs
- ModsData and other data folders now stay loose on install
- Saving a config in Virtual Mod Mode now always reaches the game
- Renamed Newer Version of your Installed Nexus File to Update This Mod
- Removed Beta tag from Virtual Mod Mode
- Removed Import collection via link (use the Vortex/Mod Manager Download button on Nexus)
- Removed the NXM link received banner
- Updated all languages to match English
- some are most likely not listed above
